reason: I'd grab the free first visit for sure, but we'd only go once or twice a month, so $15 a pop plus whatever the kid wants to eat adds up fast and a membership makes no sense for us. I wait for a Groupon or a deal before paying full price for something new.
objection: With shift work we can't go on a steady schedule, so I'd be paying $15 a visit for something we use once or twice a month. The 5-pack is the only thing that might work, and I'd want to see it go on a deal first.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or a launch deal like a 5-visit pack for around $40, or drop-in at $10 on weekday mornings.
